title: 蚊虫传的病，怎么防
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/46_VECTOR-BORNE DISEASES MALARIA, DENGUE % CHIKUNGUNYA.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/46_VECTOR-BORNE DISEASES MALARIA, DENGUE % CHIKUNGUNYA/src.py

points.K12: 疟原虫在人和蚊之间轮转
points.K15: 蚊子何时叮，被什么吸引
points.K20: 登革热的症状和危险信号
points.K31: 社区监测，与主管部门合作

shots.scene: 欣欣站在校园草坪上，一只卡通蚊子在旁边飞，欣欣摆手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands on a campus lawn waving away a cartoon mosquito flying nearby.
shots.narration: 小小一只蚊子，能传好几种病。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起蚊子、苍蝇、白蛉三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three icons: a mosquito, a housefly and a tiny sandfly.
shots.narration: 今天讲虫媒传染病的防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验楼门口拍手打蚊子，胳膊上有红包
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slaps at a mosquito outside the lab building, with red bite bumps on his arm.
shots.narration: 阿杰被蚊子叮了一身包。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张空白出差通知，表情兴奋
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank field trip notice and looks excited.
shots.narration: 下个月，他要去南方野外采样。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑前看一张蚊子分布地图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks at a mosquito distribution map on a computer.
shots.narration: 小研正在查本地的蚊媒数据。

shots.scene: 王老师走过来，手里拿着驱蚊剂和空白手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over holding a repellent bottle and a blank handbook.
shots.narration: 王老师：防蚊这件事，可不小。

shots.scene: 白板上画着蚊子、疾病、温度计、盾牌四个图标
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with four icons: a mosquito, a virus particle, a thermometer and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 认识媒介、疾病、症状和防控。

shots.scene: 热带森林边的村庄，树上一只长鼻子猴
shots.prompt_en: A village at the edge of a tropical forest with a long-nosed monkey sitting in a tree. No people.
shots.narration: 森林里的长鼻猴，带诺氏疟原虫。

shots.scene: 箭头从猴子经过蚊子指向人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Arrows from a monkey icon through a mosquito icon to a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 蚊子叮了猴再叮人，就传给了人。

shots.scene: 地球图标旁边一个人数柱
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon beside a bar chart with a highlighted bar. No people.
shots.narration: 虫媒病每年全球约四十万人死亡。

shots.scene: 心脏、大脑图标的柱子更高，蚊子柱稍矮但亮起
shots.prompt_en: Taller bars with heart and brain icons beside a shorter glowing bar with a mosquito icon. No people.
shots.narration: 比心脑血管病少，但绝不能忽视。

shots.scene: 蝙蝠、病毒、人、人群四个图标连成箭头
shots.prompt_en: A chain of icons connected by arrows: a bat, a virus particle, a person and a crowd. No people.
shots.narration: 很多新病，是从动物传到人的。

shots.scene: 蚊子和病原之间一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: A large question mark between a mosquito icon and a microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 媒介和病原的关系，还有很多未知。

shots.scene: 病人图标和蚊子图标各被虚线框住，人群在旁安全
shots.prompt_en: A patient icon and a mosquito icon each enclosed in a dashed box, with a safe crowd beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 管住病人，也管住蚊子。

shots.scene: 人群上方出现一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A shield appears over a crowd icon. No people.
shots.narration: 传播链一断，社区就安全了。

shots.scene: 森林被砍伐，挖掘机图标
shots.prompt_en: A cleared forest with tree stumps and an excavator. No people.
shots.narration: 砍伐森林，打破了自然平衡。

shots.scene: 蚊子的天敌图标消失，蚊子数量变多
shots.prompt_en: A natural enemy icon fades away and the number of mosquito icons multiplies. No people.
shots.narration: 蚊子的天敌少了，蚊子就多了。

shots.scene: 发红的地球和温度计
shots.prompt_en: A reddish globe next to a rising thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 气候变化，也让疟疾在一些地方回潮。

shots.scene: 一张空白表格，四行各有一个小病毒图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank table with four rows, each with a small virus icon. No people.
shots.narration: 看看本地公布的病例数据。

shots.scene: 地球图标、骷髅图标、小孩图标三行
shots.prompt_en: Three rows of icons: a globe, a skull and a small child. No people.
shots.narration: 全球约2.29亿病例，40.6万死亡。

shots.scene: 小孩图标被放大，旁边红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: An enlarged small child icon with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 约67%是五岁以下的孩子。

shots.scene: 偏远村庄，没有信号的手机图标
shots.prompt_en: A remote village with a phone icon showing no signal. No people.
shots.narration: 偏远地区还有很多没报上来。

shots.scene: 古埃及木乃伊棺图标，旁边放大镜
shots.prompt_en: An ancient Egyptian coffin icon with a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 古埃及木乃伊里，就有疟疾证据。

shots.scene: 老式显微镜旁一个日历图标
shots.prompt_en: An old-fashioned microscope next to a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 1880年，人们首次找到这种原虫。

shots.scene: 五个不同颜色的小圆点图标
shots.prompt_en: Five small dot icons in different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 能感染人的疟原虫有五种。

shots.scene: 其中一个圆点最大
shots.prompt_en: One of the five dot icons is much larger than the others. No people.
shots.narration: 其中恶性疟最常见，也最凶。

shots.scene: 卵、幼虫、蛹、成蚊四格循环图
shots.prompt_en: A four-stage circular diagram: egg raft, larva, pupa and adult mosquito. No people.
shots.narration: 从卵到成蚊，只要八到十天。

shots.scene: 云朵和太阳交替，地上积水
shots.prompt_en: Alternating rain clouds and sunshine over small puddles on the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 雨一阵晴一阵，积水最易孳生蚊子。

shots.section_title: 疟原虫在人和蚊之间轮转
shots.scene: 人和蚊子之间一个双向循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A two-way circular arrow between a person icon and a mosquito icon. No people.
shots.narration: 疟原虫一半时间在蚊里，一半在人里。
overlay: 疟原虫在人和蚊之间轮转

shots.section_title: 疟原虫在人和蚊之间轮转
shots.scene: 蚊子叮咬病人图标，再飞向健康人图标
shots.prompt_en: A mosquito icon bites a sick person icon and then flies toward a healthy person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 蚊子叮病人，再叮别人，就传开了。

shots.scene: 发烧的人形图标，温度计升高
shots.prompt_en: A person icon with a fever and a rising thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 潜伏约十到十五天，开始发热。

shots.scene: 发冷发抖与贫血图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a shivering person and a pale blood drop. No people.
shots.narration: 忽冷忽热，孩子会严重贫血。

shots.scene: 大脑图标亮起红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A brain icon flashing a red warning. No people.
shots.narration: 重的会伤到大脑，危及生命。

shots.scene: 一个看起来健康的人带着小疟原虫图标走向别处
shots.prompt_en: A healthy-looking person icon carrying a tiny parasite icon walks toward another region on a map. No people.
shots.narration: 没症状的带虫者，也可能传给别人。

shots.scene: 医院图标和时钟
shots.prompt_en: A hospital icon next to a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 有症状，要尽快就医。

shots.scene: 显微镜和一张血涂片图标
shots.prompt_en: A microscope next to a blood smear slide icon. No people.
shots.narration: 传统靠血涂片镜检，需要经验。

shots.scene: 核酸检测仪和荧光图标
shots.prompt_en: A nucleic acid test instrument icon and a fluorescence icon. No people.
shots.narration: 核酸检测更准，还能分清虫种。

shots.scene: 荧光图标旁一个价签
shots.prompt_en: A fluorescence icon beside a price tag. No people.
shots.narration: 荧光抗体检测也行，就是比较贵。

shots.section_title: 蚊子何时叮，被什么吸引
shots.scene: 日出和日落两幅小图
shots.prompt_en: Two small pictures of sunrise and sunset. No people.
shots.narration: 蚊子在早晚最活跃。
overlay: 蚊子何时叮，被什么吸引

shots.section_title: 蚊子何时叮，被什么吸引
shots.scene: 白天太阳下也有一只蚊子
shots.prompt_en: A mosquito flying under the midday sun. No people.
shots.narration: 可白天也会叮人，不能大意。

shots.section_title: 蚊子何时叮，被什么吸引
shots.scene: 呼气、体温、香水、汗水、蓝绿光五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: exhaled breath, body heat, a perfume bottle, sweat drops and a blue-green light. No people.
shots.narration: 呼气、体温、香水、汗味都招蚊子。

shots.scene: 自己从药箱拿药吃的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of someone taking pills from a medicine box by themselves, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 预防和治疗，都不能自己乱吃药。

shots.scene: 药丸图标旁边一个盾牌碎裂
shots.prompt_en: A pill icon beside a cracking shield. No people.
shots.narration: 乱用药，病原就会耐药。

shots.scene: 阿杰在医院门诊向医生咨询
shots.prompt_en: The young male student consults a doctor at a hospital clinic.
shots.narration: 去流行区前，先问医生。

shots.scene: 旧药瓶图标上有破盾牌
shots.prompt_en: An old medicine bottle icon with a broken shield. No people.
shots.narration: 氯喹有长期毒性，也普遍耐药。

shots.scene: 一株青蒿和一本古籍
shots.prompt_en: A sweet wormwood plant beside an old book. No people.
shots.narration: 屠呦呦从古籍和青蒿中找到青蒿素。

shots.scene: 青蒿图标旁边一枚奖章
shots.prompt_en: A medal next to the sweet wormwood plant icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这一发现，获得了诺贝尔奖。

shots.scene: 疟原虫图标不断换颜色
shots.prompt_en: A parasite icon keeps changing color. No people.
shots.narration: 疟原虫会不断“变装”，疫苗难做。

shots.scene: 疫苗瓶图标和一个日历，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: A vaccine vial icon next to a calendar and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 讲者说：目前还没有获批疫苗。

shots.scene: 贫困地区的村庄和慢慢走的时钟
shots.prompt_en: A poor village with a slow-moving clock. No people.
shots.narration: 贫困地区，往往最晚用上新疫苗。

shots.scene: 一只黑白条纹的伊蚊
shots.prompt_en: A black-and-white striped mosquito. No people.
shots.narration: 登革热由伊蚊传播。

shots.scene: 两只伊蚊图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two striped mosquito icons side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 埃及伊蚊、白纹伊蚊都会传。

shots.scene: 四个不同颜色的病毒图标
shots.prompt_en: Four virus icons in four different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 病毒有四个型，可能感染不止一次。

shots.scene: 地球上许多红点
shots.prompt_en: A globe covered with many red dots. No people.
shots.narration: 全球每年感染一到四亿人。

shots.section_title: 登革热的症状和危险信号
shots.scene: 四个人形中一个在发热
shots.prompt_en: Four person icons, one of them with a fever. No people.
shots.narration: 多数感染者没症状，约四分之一发病。
overlay: 登革热的症状和危险信号

shots.section_title: 登革热的症状和危险信号
shots.scene: 发热、眼眶痛、关节痛、皮疹四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a thermometer, an aching eye, an aching joint and a skin rash. No people.
shots.narration: 发热，眼眶后痛，肌肉关节痛。

shots.section_title: 登革热的症状和危险信号
shots.scene: 一周日历，人形恢复健康
shots.prompt_en: A one-week calendar with a person icon recovering. No people.
shots.narration: 多数人一周左右好转。

shots.section_title: 登革热的症状和危险信号
shots.scene: 红色警示三角和出血图标
shots.prompt_en: A red warning triangle with a bleeding icon. No people.
shots.narration: 便血、呕血是重症信号，马上就医！

shots.scene: 救护车和医院图标
shots.prompt_en: An ambulance and a hospital icon. No people.
shots.narration: 怀疑登革热，尽快去医院。

shots.scene: 核酸检测管图标和对勾
shots.prompt_en: A test tube icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 医院会用核酸检测确诊。

shots.scene: 一杯水和一盒止痛药图标
shots.prompt_en: A glass of water beside a pain relief tablet box icon. No people.
shots.narration: 没法就医，才用对乙酰氨基酚。

shots.scene: 一杯水和水滴图标
shots.prompt_en: A glass of water with water drop icons. No people.
shots.narration: 同时多补水。

shots.scene: 疫苗瓶图标旁边一个人形和对勾
shots.prompt_en: A vaccine vial icon next to a person icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 有的登革疫苗，只适合感染过的人。

shots.scene: 几面空白旗子，各配对勾或叉
shots.prompt_en: Several blank flags, each with a tick or a cross. No people.
shots.narration: 各国的批准情况不一样。

shots.scene: 一只雄蚊图标带着DNA图标
shots.prompt_en: A male mosquito icon carrying a DNA icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有的地方释放转基因雄蚊。

shots.scene: 蚊子后代图标停止生长
shots.prompt_en: Mosquito offspring icons stopping before they grow up. No people.
shots.narration: 让后代长不大，压低蚊群。

shots.scene: 审批印章和天平
shots.prompt_en: An approval stamp next to a balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 释放要经审批，至今仍有争议。

shots.scene: 蚊子体内一个小细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: A tiny bacterium icon inside a mosquito outline. No people.
shots.narration: 还有一种共生细菌，能管住蚊子。

shots.scene: 病例曲线明显下降
shots.prompt_en: A case curve dropping sharply on a chart. No people.
shots.narration: 某地试验，登革热降了约77%。

shots.scene: 伊蚊和关节痛图标
shots.prompt_en: A striped mosquito icon next to an aching joint icon. No people.
shots.narration: 基孔肯雅热，也是伊蚊传的。

shots.scene: 发热和关节肿痛的人形
shots.prompt_en: A person icon with fever and swollen aching joints. No people.
shots.narration: 高热，关节痛得厉害。

shots.scene: 长长的日历和关节图标
shots.prompt_en: A long calendar with a joint icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有人关节痛会持续很久。

shots.scene: 核酸检测仪图标和一面盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A nucleic acid test icon beside a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 分子方法检测，康复后有免疫。

shots.scene: 一只家蝇停在食物上，食物上有细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: A housefly landing on food with bacteria icons on the food. No people.
shots.narration: 家蝇身上带大量细菌。

shots.scene: 肠道、腹泻图标
shots.prompt_en: An intestine icon with a diarrhea warning. No people.
shots.narration: 落在食物上，能传肠道传染病。

shots.scene: 四个肠道病原的空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards with gut microbe icons. No people.
shots.narration: 痢疾、伤寒、霍乱都可能传。

shots.scene: 一只很小的白蛉和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A very tiny sandfly under a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 白蛉很小，叮人几乎没感觉。

shots.scene: 皮肤上一个红肿包和抓痒的手
shots.prompt_en: A red swollen bump on skin with a scratching hand. No people.
shots.narration: 过后又肿又痒，还可能传黑热病。

shots.scene: 阴暗潮湿、落叶腐烂的角落
shots.prompt_en: A dark damp corner with rotting leaves. No people.
shots.narration: 它在潮湿阴暗的腐烂物里孳生。

shots.scene: 志愿者们在社区清理积水
shots.prompt_en: Volunteers clean up standing water around a neighborhood; the young male student and the female graduate student help.
shots.narration: 社区里，我们能做什么？

shots.scene: 房屋、蚊子路径、喷雾瓶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a habitat house, a mosquito flight path and a spray bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 先了解蚊子住哪、怎么传、怕什么。

shots.scene: 蚊子计数器和图表
shots.prompt_en: A mosquito counter icon next to a chart. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估：统计蚊子有多少。

shots.scene: 杀虫剂喷雾过量的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of excessive insecticide spraying, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 控制要适度，乱喷药会产生抗药性。

shots.scene: 日历上标出前后两次计数
shots.prompt_en: A calendar marking two counts before and after control. No people.
shots.narration: 做完后，再数一数看效果。

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上的彩色地图
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing a colorful map with hotspots. No people.
shots.narration: 公开的数据和地图，能实时追踪疫情。

shots.scene: 数据图表指向决策图标
shots.prompt_en: A chart with an arrow pointing to a decision checkmark. No people.
shots.narration: 用数据做决定。

shots.section_title: 社区监测，与主管部门合作
shots.scene: 志愿者与穿制服的防疫人员握手
shots.prompt_en: A volunteer shakes hands with a public health worker in a uniform.
shots.narration: 社区监测，要和卫生部门一起做。
overlay: 社区监测，与主管部门合作

shots.section_title: 社区监测，与主管部门合作
shots.scene: 地图上标出积水点
shots.prompt_en: A neighborhood map with standing water spots marked. No people.
shots.narration: 找出容易积水孳生的地方。

shots.section_title: 社区监测，与主管部门合作
shots.scene: 施工工地和积水坑
shots.prompt_en: A construction site with puddles. No people.
shots.narration: 留意施工带来的新积水。

shots.scene: 一个空白的诱蚊器外壳图标
shots.prompt_en: A plain mosquito trap outline icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用诱蚊器监测蚊子数量。

shots.scene: 两种诱蚊器图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two different mosquito trap outline icons side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 有的诱成蚊，有的诱产卵的雌蚊。

shots.scene: 第三种诱蚊器图标，箭头指向积水
shots.prompt_en: A third trap outline icon with an arrow pointing to standing water. No people.
shots.narration: 还有让蚊子把灭幼剂带回去的。

shots.scene: 居民区地图上几个固定点位
shots.prompt_en: A residential map with several fixed trap location pins. No people.
shots.narration: 居民区定点，和主管部门商量好。

shots.scene: 工作人员每天检查诱蚊器，日历打勾
shots.prompt_en: A public health worker checks a trap with a calendar ticked daily.
shots.narration: 每天检查，防止破损逃逸。

shots.scene: 药剂瓶旁边的水源图标，警示
shots.prompt_en: A chemical bottle next to a water source icon with a warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 灭幼药剂按规定用，别污染水源。

shots.scene: 天平一边是数据，一边是措施
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a chart on one side and a spray bottle on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 措施轻重，要看监测数据。

shots.scene: 蚊子图标上一个很小的百分比
shots.prompt_en: A mosquito icon with a very small percentage badge. No people.
shots.narration: 带毒率很低，就不必大动干戈。

shots.scene: 蚊帐和纱窗
shots.prompt_en: A bed net and a window screen. No people.
shots.narration: 蚊帐纱窗，是最基本的屏障。

shots.scene: 倒掉花盆托盘和废轮胎里的积水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student empties water from a flowerpot tray and an old tire.
shots.narration: 清除积水，断了蚊子的家。

shots.scene: 香茅草和驱蚊液瓶，旁边过敏提示
shots.prompt_en: Lemongrass beside a repellent bottle with an allergy check icon. No people.
shots.narration: 香茅油等驱避剂，先试过不过敏。

shots.scene: 化学药剂和生物防治两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a chemical spray and a beneficial microbe. No people.
shots.narration: 化学用除虫菊酯，生物用细菌和蚊。

shots.scene: 社区居民、政府楼、实验室三个图标手拉手
shots.prompt_en: Three icons holding hands: residents, a government building and a laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 防蚊不是一次的事，要长期坚持。

shots.scene: 实验室人员在鉴定蚊种
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory worker examines mosquito specimens under a microscope.
shots.narration: 专家鉴定蚊种、检测带毒情况。

shots.scene: 公众、政府、钱袋三个图标连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the public, a government building and a money bag joined in a ring. No people.
shots.narration: 需要公众参与和政府长期投入。

shots.scene: 地球被一圈手拉手的人包围
shots.prompt_en: A globe surrounded by a ring of people icons holding hands. No people.
shots.narration: 人人参与，共建更安全的世界。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现蚊帐、积水桶、驱避剂图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a bed net, an emptied bucket and a repellent bottle.
shots.narration: 防叮咬，清积水，是最好的预防。

shots.scene: 天平一边是数据，一边是措施
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a chart on one side and a spray bottle on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 看数据，控制要适度。

shots.scene: 药丸图标被打叉，旁边医生图标
shots.prompt_en: A pill icon crossed out with a red X next to a doctor icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不自行用药，一切遵医嘱。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着长袖背上背包，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in long sleeves with a backpack gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰：这回出门，我准备好了。

shots.scene: 欣欣、小研、阿杰和王老师在校园里挥手，旁边一只蚊子被挡在纱窗外
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student, the young male student and the safety administrator wave goodbye on campus while a mosquito is blocked by a window screen.
shots.narration: 防好蚊虫，健康同行，再见！
